name: Save data (browser)
summary: Keeps the app's records on the phone or computer, offline, with ids added for you. Backup to a file (and restore) so data can move by USB or messaging.
use: const db = new Store('farm'); db.add('harvests', {crop: 'maize', kg: 40}); db.list('harvests')

points.note: Everything is saved as text in the browser's localStorage; if the phone's storage is full it says so instead of silently losing data.
Gives each record the next id and the time it was added.
